words.en: A large wild cat that has a yellowish-brown or brown coat with black spots, found in Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.tr:
v. 舔；（火焰）掠过；克服
n. 舔；少许
words.ex: The dog licks its paw.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔它的爪子。
words.en: To pass the tongue over something; to defeat someone easily.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr: n. 照明；灯光； v. “light”的现在分词；
words.ex: The room has good lighting.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间照明很好。
words.en: The arrangement or type of light in a place.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 活着的； n. 生活；生计； v. 生活；“live”的现在分词；
words.ex: The living animals need water and food.
words.ex_cn: 活着的动物需要水和食物。
words.en: The state of being alive; the experience of being alive; a particular way or style of life.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.ex: He calls his parents every week using long-distance phone service.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都用长途电话服务给父母打电话。
words.en: Involving or covering a long distance.

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: I love the lyrics of this song.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这首歌的歌词。
words.en: The words of a song, especially a pop song.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: Mankind needs to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护环境。
words.en: Human beings considered collectively; the human race.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.tr: n. 制造业； v. 制造；“manufacture”的现在分词；
words.ex: Manufacturing is important for the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 制造业对国家经济很重要。
words.en: The process of converting raw materials into finished products, especially by means of a large-scale industrial operation.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: He solved a mathematical problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了一个数学问题。
words.en: Relating to or using mathematics; precise and exact.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 环保的；有利于环境的
words.ex: This bag is environmentally friendly.
words.ex_cn: 这个袋子对环境友好。
words.en: Environmentally friendly refers to goods, services, laws, guidelines, and policies that inflict minimal or no harm upon the environment or ecosystems.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr: adv. 精神上；思想上；智力上；
words.ex: He is mentally strong despite his challenges.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，他在精神上很坚强。
words.en: In a manner relating to the mind or mental processes.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: She added a mint leaf to her drink.
words.ex_cn: 她在饮料里加了一片薄荷叶。
words.en: Mint is a plant with fresh-tasting leaves. It is also the place where coins are made, or the act of making coins.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: He felt deep misery after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: Misery is a state of great unhappiness and emotional distress.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.ex: The morning was misty and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 早晨雾蒙蒙的，很安静。
words.en: If the weather is misty, there is mist in the air that makes it difficult to see far.

words.ex: He misunderstands the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了这些说明。
words.en: If you misunderstand someone or something, you do not understand them properly.

words.tr: n. 误解；误会； v. “misunderstand”的现在分词；
words.ex: There was a misunderstanding between them about the time.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间对时间产生了误解。
words.en: A misunderstanding is a failure to understand something correctly, often leading to confusion or disagreement.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr:
n. 月光
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
words.ex: She works as a waitress at night to moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 她晚上当服务员来兼职。
words.en: The light that comes from the moon at night.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.ex: He refused the money, because morally it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了那笔钱，因为道义上这是不对的。
words.en: In a manner relating to principles of right and wrong behavior.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.ex: My mother-in-law lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的岳母住在隔壁。
words.en: The mother of one's spouse.

words.tr: adj. 有动机的；有积极性的； v. 激发；“motivate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is motivated to study hard for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他有动力努力为考试学习。
words.en: If you are motivated by something, especially a strong emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 感叹号；感叹标记（用于句子末尾表示强烈情感或惊呼的标点符号）
words.ex: The exclamation mark is used to express strong feelings.
words.ex_cn: 感叹号用于表达强烈的情感。
words.en: A punctuation mark (!) used after an exclamation.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: The motorist stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这位驾车者在红灯前停下了车。
words.en: A motorist is a person who drives a car.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: v. 移动；“move”的现在分词；搬家； adj. 运动的；感人的；动人的；可移动的；
words.ex: The boy is moving his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩正在移动他的玩具车。
words.en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly touched or emotional.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.tr: adj. 泥泞的；模糊不清的；
words.ex: The road became muddy after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，这条路变得泥泞。
words.en: If something is muddy, it is covered in mud or full of mud. If you muddy something, you make it muddy or you make it less clear or more complicated.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；含糊地说
n. 含糊的话；咕哝
words.ex: He mumbles when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会嘟囔。
words.en: If you mumble, you speak very quietly and not at all clearly with the result that the words are difficult to understand.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
n. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
words.ex: He mutters under his breath when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 当他生气时，他会低声嘟囔。
words.en: To speak or say something in a low voice that is hard to hear, often because you are annoyed or complaining.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: He narrowly passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他勉强通过了考试。
words.en: In a way that is only just achieved or avoided; closely.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.ex: The nation celebrated its independence day.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家庆祝了它的独立日。
words.en: A nation is a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture, and history, who live in a particular area under one government.

words.tr:
adj. 全国性的；
adv. 在全国范围内；
words.ex: The nationwide campaign helped many families.
words.ex_cn: 这项全国性的活动帮助了许多家庭。
words.en: Extending or occurring throughout a whole nation.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: The naughty boy broke his mother's vase.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩打碎了他妈妈的花瓶。
words.en: If you say that a child is naughty, you mean that they behave badly or do not do what they are told.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: She picked up a needle to sew the button.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一根针来缝纽扣。
words.en: A needle is a thin, pointed piece of metal that is used in sewing. It has a hole at one end for thread to pass through.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.ex: The neighbouring town has a big market.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的城镇有一个大市场。
words.en: Neighbouring places are next to or near each other.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.tr: n. [解剖]神经；神经紧张；胆量（nerve 的复数）；
words.ex: The nerves in his hand sent pain signals to his brain.
words.ex_cn: 他手里的神经向大脑传递了疼痛信号。
words.en: Nerves are the fibers that carry messages between your brain and other parts of your body, allowing you to move and feel things. They can also refer to feelings of worry or anxiety about something that is going to happen.

words.tr: adv. 紧张地；不安地；焦躁地；神经质地
words.ex: He spoke nervously in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前紧张地说话。
words.en: In a manner that shows you are worried or frightened.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: He was newly hired as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他最近被聘为老师。
words.en: Newly means something that has happened or been done recently.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.ex: She cleaned the room nicely.
words.ex_cn: 她把房间打扫得很好。
words.en: In a pleasant or agreeable manner.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.ex: This is a non-smoking room.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个无烟房间。
words.en: Non-smoking refers to areas or policies where smoking is not allowed.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He is a famous novelist who writes stories about love.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的作家，写关于爱情的故事。
words.en: A novelist is a person who writes novels.

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在正在吃饭。
words.en: at the present time or moment

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.ex: I occasionally walk my dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔在公园遛狗。
words.en: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船离开了岸边。
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: He was arrested for a serious offence.
words.ex_cn: 他因严重犯罪被逮捕。
words.en: An offence is a crime or a violation of a rule or law.

words.ex: He offended the law by stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他偷窃触犯了法律。
words.en: If you offend someone, you upset or embarrass them by saying or doing something that they think is rude or insulting.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后常常去公园。
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上。
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶或者咖啡。
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.tr: phrase. 厌烦的；受够了的；极度不满的
words.ex: I am fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: If you are fed up, you are unhappy, bored, or tired of something, especially something that you have been experiencing for a long time.

words.tr: adj. 管弦乐的；管弦乐队的；
words.ex: The orchestra played an orchestral piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 乐团在音乐会上演奏了一首管弦乐作品。
words.en: Relating to or written for an orchestra.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: He is the organizer of the school fair.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校集市的组织者。
words.en: An organizer is a person who arranges or plans an event or activity.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 他走出了房间。
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: adj. 极无礼的；粗暴的；骇人的；
words.ex: His outrageous behavior made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他极无礼的行为让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as outrageous, you are emphasizing that it is unacceptable because it is extremely bad, immoral, or shocking.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: The table has an oval shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。
words.en: An oval is a shape that is like a circle but is longer in one direction than the other.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: The owl sleeps in the tree during the day.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰白天在树上睡觉。
words.en: An owl is a bird with a flat face, large eyes, and a small sharp beak. Most owls hunt at night.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.tr: adj. 充满...的；挤满人的；拥挤的； v. 包装；“pack”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was packed with people.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上挤满了人。
words.en: Filled with a large number of people or things.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.ex: He spent all day doing paperwork.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在处理文书工作。
words.en: Paperwork refers to the routine work involving written documents such as forms, reports, and letters, especially in an office setting.

words.tr:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞；用降落伞空投
words.ex: He jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.ex_cn: 他从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
words.en: A parachute is a device used to slow the motion of an object through an atmosphere by creating drag.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.ex: She sings passionately in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她在人群前热烈地唱歌。
words.en: If you are passionate about something, you have very strong feelings about it or a strong belief in it.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: The fire brigade was called to the scene within minutes.
words.ex_cn: 消防队在几分钟内就赶到了现场。
words.en: A fire brigade is an organization which has the job of putting out fires; used especially to refer to the people who actually fight the fires.

words.ex: She waited patiently for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 她耐心地等公交车。
words.en: In a patient manner; with patience.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.ex: The cat licked its paw.
words.ex_cn: 猫舔它的爪子。
words.en: The foot of an animal that has claws or nails, such as a cat, dog, or bear.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: Her first language is Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 她的母语是中文。
words.en: A first language is the language that a person has learned from birth or within the critical period, or that a person speaks the best and so is often the basis for sociolinguistic identity.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr: adv. 和平地；平静地；和谐地
words.ex: The village is nestled peacefully in the valley.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄平静地坐落在山谷中。
words.en: In a manner that is free from disturbance or conflict; calmly.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.tr: adv. 完美地；圆满地；完全地；
words.ex: She sang perfectly in the concert.
words.ex_cn: 她在演唱会上唱得完美极了。
words.en: In a perfect manner; completely or entirely.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.tr:
adj. 吓呆的；惊呆的；目瞪口呆的
v. （使）石化；（使）僵化；吓呆；“petrify”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She stood petrified at the sight of the snake.
words.ex_cn: 她看到蛇时吓得呆住了。
words.en: If you are petrified, you are extremely frightened, perhaps so frightened that you cannot think or move.

words.ex: The pharmacist gave me medicine for my cough.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师给了我治咳嗽的药。
words.en: A pharmacist is a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense medicinal drugs.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: His politeness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他的礼貌让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Politeness is the practical application of good manners or etiquette so as not to offend others.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: The popularity of this song grew quickly on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上的流行迅速增长。
words.en: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr: adj. 豪华的；漂亮的； 优雅的；时髦的
words.ex: He wears posh clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿得很时髦去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as posh, you mean that it is smart, fashionable, and expensive.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He positively believes in his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他积极地相信自己的梦想。
words.en: In a positive manner; with certainty.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: He will possibly come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天可能会来。
words.en: You use possibly to indicate that something is true or might be true, but you are not certain.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: She spoke powerfully about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 她强烈地谈论了气候变化。
words.en: In a manner that is powerful; with great strength or intensity.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.ex: He ordered fried prawn for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了炸对虾。
words.en: A prawn is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: The clock strikes precisely at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟恰好在正午敲响。
words.en: In a precise manner; exactly.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.ex: You can take the bus, preferably early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 你可以坐公交车，最好是在早上早些时候。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferably to another, you mean that the first thing is more desirable or suitable than the second.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr:
n. 前缀
v. 在…前面加
words.ex: He adds a prefix to the word to change its meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他在单词前加上前缀来改变它的意思。
words.en: A prefix is a letter or group of letters added at the beginning of a word to change its meaning.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr: adj. 有准备的；准备好的； v. 准备；预备；“prepare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试做好了准备。
words.en: If you are prepared for something, you are ready for it or have made plans in advance to deal with it.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: n. 演讲人；节目主持人；发言人；呈献者；
words.ex: The presenter told a funny story to the audience.
words.ex_cn: 演讲人给观众讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A presenter is a person who introduces or hosts a television or radio program, or who introduces a speaker or performer at a public event.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: n. 总统职位；总统任期
words.ex: He won the presidency in 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他在2020年赢得了总统职位。
words.en: The position or term of office of a president.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: The painting is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是无价的。
words.en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money, or that it is very important to you and you could not replace it.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.
